name: d2_class_app
request: I teach evening classes and need an app to keep track of my students and courses. I should have to log in first - my username is teacher and my password is chalk77. After logging in I want a dashboard that shows how many students I have, how many courses I have, and how many students are under 18. I need a Students page where I can add a student (name, email and age) and search students by name. I need a Courses page where I can add a course (title and fee) and search courses by title. Everything must be saved in a database so nothing is lost if the app restarts, and it must work well on a phone.
